advisories.description:
### Summary

Telegraf 1.41.0 fixes a CVE in the Go standard library that affects HTTP listener plugins with TLS enabled.

### Details

#### Go toolchain

Updated to Go 1.27.4 to fix the following CVE in the Go standard library, which was confirmed to affect Telegraf.

- [CVE-2026-00001](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-0001): net/http: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion from unbounded CONTINUATION frames.

#### Patches

Fixed in Telegraf 1.41.0.

#### Workarounds

Set `tls_allowed_cacerts` on the listener plugins to require a client certificate.

#### References

- [Telegraf 1.41.0 release notes](https://docs.influxdata.com/telegraf/v1/release-notes/#v1410)

### Proof of concept

InfluxData does not publish reproduction steps for this issue. The configuration that exposes it is described under Impact. Upgrade to Telegraf 1.41.0 or apply the workaround under Details.

### Impact

- Denial of service against HTTP listener plugins: CVE-2026-00001 lets any client that can reach the listener exhaust the agent's memory. Agents are affected when `inputs.http_listener_v2` or `inputs.influxdb_listener` has `tls_cert` and `tls_key` set.

Agents that do not run one of these plugins with TLS are not affected.

### Updates

- 2026-10-21: Widened the affected range after CVE-2026-00001 was confirmed to affect earlier releases.

advisories.description:
### Summary

Telegraf 1.40.4 and Telegraf Controller 1.3.0 fix a credential exposure in the debug logs of the `inputs.http` plugin and in the Telegraf Controller request log.

### Details

#### Credential exposure in inputs.http debug logs (CVE-2026-31499)

CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N (6.2, Medium)

When debug logging is enabled, the `inputs.http` plugin logs full request headers. Telegraf Controller logs the same headers when it tests a configuration that uses the plugin.

#### Patches

Fixed in Telegraf 1.40.4 and Telegraf Controller 1.3.0.

#### Workarounds

Disable debug logging.

#### References

- [Telegraf 1.40.4 release notes](https://docs.influxdata.com/telegraf/v1/release-notes/#v1404)

### Proof of concept

InfluxData does not publish reproduction steps for this issue. The configuration that exposes it is described under Details: `inputs.http` with `debug = true`. Upgrade to Telegraf 1.40.4 and Telegraf Controller 1.3.0 or disable debug logging.

### Impact

Credential exposure: anyone with read access to the logs can recover the credentials the plugin sends.
